plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Art (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Art & Art Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Art (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints a single combined line, Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; the map expressly does not include the B.A.'s 16-credit foreign-language requirement (the B.S. requirement is 12 credits). Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/16/15/15/15/15/15/13) and the plan to 120. Cross-check: the catalog's Art Curriculum totals 43 credits (Art Foundation Courses 28; Art Elective Courses 15 = 12 credits of ART studio courses plus 3 credits of ARTH 3760 or ARTH 4750), and all ten named Foundation courses appear in the map. The map's four generic ART studio elective rows total exactly the catalog's 12 studio credits, and its final generic ARTH elective row is the catalog's ARTH 3760 / ARTH 4750 choice, recorded as a choice slot with both options. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
